scope: All 15 residual whole-token posledn- adjective forms in live v019 Latin sources.
choice: Normalize the source-spelled posledn- forms to the official poslědnji/poslědny family while preserving case, gender, number, and capitalization.
motivation: The official type-1 lemma and the dominant existing edition family use poslědn-. The 15 posledn- forms carry no distinct meaning and were an inconsistent source-layer spelling.
alternatives_rejected: Retain both spellings as free variants; that preserves needless inconsistency in a high-frequency adjective.
Replace the lemma with a branch-specific synonym such as zadnji or ostatni; the official poslědn- form already has broad cross-family support.
